command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: ipmitool chassis status is inapplicable to the Redfish procedure. The literal curl is unsafe and assumes /Systems/system; moreover that URI represents a ComputerSystem resource rather than a Chassis resource unless the project explicitly defines different semantics.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Discover the actual Systems member and linked Chassis resource, then use a certificate-validating Redfish client to GET the engineer-selected target and validate its true resource type/schema/fields.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Authenticated read of literal /redfish/v1/Systems/system, data readability/correctness and 5/5-minute estimates are preserved as source facts pending resource-identity resolution.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Treat service-root discovery, Systems member resolution and Links.Chassis traversal as evidence; select the approved resource, pin its @odata.id/type/schema and compare a versioned semantic field matrix.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Eliminates hardcoded member ID, insecure credentials/TLS and IPMI substitution while distinguishing ComputerSystem from Chassis resource identity.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Readable JSON from /Systems/system cannot by itself prove a Chassis resource or its values. The correct resource type, relationship and owner-defined fields must be explicit.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: OEM paths and fields vary by firmware. The review cannot infer whether the title or literal URI is authoritative or what the stray 'sm' means.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items says Chassis, but the Procedure queries /redfish/v1/Systems/system, which normally identifies a ComputerSystem member rather than a Chassis resource; Criteria also contains an unexplained trailing 'sm'. The authoritative resource and exact correctness contract are therefore unresolved.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The identity conflict prevents execution/verdict but is precisely documented for engineering resolution, so the overall review can continue.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 1961 Wistron-BMC-00997-V002: decide whether the Chassis item owns the Procedure's /redfish/v1/Systems/{id} ComputerSystem member or its linked /redfish/v1/Chassis/{id} resource, define exact required fields/values and confirm disposition of the trailing 'sm' typo; keep row 1960 collection coverage distinct.

review_improvement: Prevents resource-type conflation and hardcoded member assumptions while preserving the literal source discrepancy for an auditable decision.
independent_technical_reasoning: Redfish resource identity is established by @odata.id and @odata.type, not by a testcase label. A Systems member can link to one or more Chassis resources, but its payload is not interchangeable with theirs. Therefore secure discovery must precede validation and engineering must choose which node in that relationship is the intended target. A parseable response at a guessed /system path only proves that one URI responded; it does not prove Chassis coverage or semantic correctness.
